Ruiqi Huang ‘29,   Political Science 
Ruiqi is a Political Science major with a Pre-Law concentration from Brighton, MA. 
He is a Research Assistant to Professor Dilshod Achilov and previously interned 
with MassPIRG's Hunger Free Campus Initiative. Ruiqi is also a recipient of the 
2026 Michael Dukakis Public Service Internship Award. Inspired by his experience 
immigrating to the United States, Ruiqi is dedicated to immigrant justice, civic 
engagement, and public service. 
Vladimir Dedic '29,   Crime & Justice Studies 
Vladimir is an Honors Crime and Justice Studies major with a Pre-Law 
concentration and a minor in French from Framingham, MA. He serves as Co- 
President of the UMass Dartmouth Mock Trial team and has volunteered with 
America Reads, reflecting his commitment to mentorship and civic engagement. 
Fluent in Serbian and aspiring to attend law school, he plans to use a legal career 
to promote access to justice and strengthen civic institutions. 
PUBLIC SERVICE INTERNSHIPS 
Eduarda Batista ‘29,   Nursing 
Eduarda is an Honors Nursing student pursuing a minor in Business Administration 
from Fall River, MA. In high school, she served as Vice President of her Astronomy 
Club and as a member of the National Honor Society. Eduarda has participated in 
the UMassD Women Lead program, served as an Early College Policy Fellow at the 
Massachusetts Alliance for Early College and as a Leader in Service at the Leduc 
Center, while also volunteering as a bilingual interpreter and theology teacher. 
Kylie Bradford Koshivaki '28,   General Managemnt 
Kylie is a Management major with a minor in Leadership and Civic Engagement 
from Ashland, MA. Her passion for community service drives her academic 
endeavors and goals of one day working for a non-profit. She currently serves as 
the Community Impact Chair for the Theta Sigma Chapter of Phi Sigma Sigma 
Sorority, and has previously interned with Make-A-Wish Massachusetts & Rhode 
Island and Elements Learning Collaborative.
